name: Rocco Forte House, Rome
positioning: Rocco Forte House: serviced private apartments with a house manager, in an 18th-century palazzo at Piazza di Spagna, Rome
best_for: Families or groups who want a private apartment with a full kitchen near the Spanish Steps
Travelers who want apartment privacy with access to Hotel de la Ville's spa, bars and restaurants

facts.text: The private apartments are within an 18th-century palazzo at Piazza di Spagna.
The address is 114 Via del Babuino, Piazza di Spagna, Rome.
The interiors are designed by Tommaso Ziffer.
Tommaso Ziffer is a Rome-based designer known for his work with the fashion house Valentino.
A dedicated house manager is on hand.
Guests get complimentary access to the Irene Forte Spa and fitness center.
Each apartment has a fully equipped kitchen.
Daily housekeeping and a House Concierge are included services.
A welcome hamper of Italian specialties is included on arrival for stays of 7 nights or more.
The Piranesi apartments are named after the Piranesi family and have original heritage features.
The Borghese apartment connects the Piranesi and Bernini apartments and is suited to groups.

highlights.text: A stately roof terrace above the apartments surveys the Spanish Steps.
The Spagna Penthouse has a private terrace with panoramic views of Piazza di Spagna and Trinita dei Monti, suited to alfresco eating.
Tall windows in the Bernini apartments look over Piazza di Spagna and the Spanish Steps.
Guests have access to the spa, the bars and the Fulvio Pierangelini restaurants of Hotel de la Ville.
Private butler service is available by the hour, by the day, or for the full stay, at a supplementary charge.

considerations.text: There is no restaurant on site.
A private chef, a breakfast basket delivered to the apartment and a nanny service are available at a supplementary charge.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.
